mission: The Hapan royal wedding ceremony; assassination attempt on the royal party intercepted by Jacen.
why_now: The wedding is the political venue the assassins have chosen.
opening_hook: Jacen at the edge of a receiving line in Hapan dress, Tenel Ka three meters away in ceremonial regalia, both of them acting strangers.
conflict: Assassin cell moving on the royal party; Jacen intercepting in a venue that forbids overt violence.
turning_point: Jacen dispatches the assassins without drawing his saber — a flex of trained violence that ends the threat before the wedding ceremony registers it.
closing_hook: The ceremony resuming with the assassin bodies already cleared; Tenel Ka's eye catching Jacen's for one beat.
setting: Hapan royal wedding chamber, Hapes Cluster; ceremonial formality.
sensory_details: Hapan silks; the chamber's polished ceremonial marble; the subsonic hum of a Force-shield the Hapan Royal Guard maintains.
emotional_trajectory: Controlled ceremonial presence → flashpoint combat → restored decorum.

stakes.personal: Jacen's cover as a ceremonial guest.

canon_elements_needed: Tenel Ka as Queen Mother with secret child
action_beats: Jacen dispatches the cell without drawing saber
notes: Allana never on-page or named. Tenel Ka peripheral.
